run_kandinsky_inpaint: run KandinskyInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image using a text prompt and mask
encode_prompt_kandinsky: encode a text prompt into CLIP embeddings using KandinskyInpaintPipeline._encode_prompt
prepare_mask_and_masked_image: prepare an image and mask pair as normalized tensors for Kandinsky inpainting
prepare_mask_erosion: prepare a mask tensor by eroding non-masked pixel neighbors with prepare_mask
compute_latent_dimensions: compute scaled height and width for latent space using get_new_h_w
